Back up existing profile.d file if present and verify sudo availability. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh
# ensure sudo usable
if ! command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'env-001: sudo not available' >&2; exit 2; fi
# verify node and npm with robust parsing
NODE_BIN=$(command -v node || true)
NPM_BIN=$(command -v npm || true)
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ] || [ -z "$NPM_BIN" ]; then echo 'env-001: node or npm not found' >&2; exit 3; fi
NODE_RAW=$($NODE_BIN --version 2>/dev/null || true)
NPM_RAW=$($NPM_BIN --version 2>/dev/null || true)
# extract numeric major safely
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_RAW" | sed -E 's/[^0-9]*([0-9]+).*/\1/' || true)
NPM_MAJOR=$(echo "$NPM_RAW" | sed -E 's/[^0-9]*([0-9]+).*/\1/' || true)
if [ -z "$NODE_MAJOR" ] || [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then echo "env-001: node version $NODE_RAW unsupported; require >=16" >&2; exit 4; fi
if [ -z "$NPM_MAJOR" ] || [ "$NPM_MAJOR" -lt 8 ]; then echo "env-001: npm version $NPM_RAW unsupported; require >=8" >&2; exit 5; fi
# detect CRA under common command names
CRA_CMD=""
for c in create-react-app cra; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && CRA_CMD="$c" && break; done
CRA_V=""
if [ -n "$CRA_CMD" ]; then CRA_V=$($CRA_CMD --version 2>/dev/null || true); fi
# compute npm global bin and prepare profile content; backup existing profile if present
NPM_G_BIN=$($NPM_BIN bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# Persist headless CRA/browser behavior for interactive shells
export BROWSER=none
EOF
if [ -n "$NPM_G_BIN" ] && [ -d "$NPM_G_BIN" ]; then
  # use runtime $PATH, do not expand current $PATH into file
  echo "# Add npm global bin to PATH if present" >> "$TMP"
  echo 'if [ -d "'"$NPM_G_BIN"'" ]; then export PATH="'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# env-001-cont: finish atomic profile write for headless CRA operation

NPM_RAW="$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || true)"

NPM_V="${NPM_RAW}"

fi

sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE" || { echo 'env-001: failed to write profile' >&2; rm -f "$TMP" || true; exit 6; }

Conditionally install devDependencies (serve, testing libs) only when missing. Fail loud on install errors. steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
cd "$WS"
# Choose package manager: respect yarn.lock if present
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PM="yarn"; else PM="npm"; fi
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'deps-001: npm ci failed' >&2; exit 8; }; else npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'deps-001: npm install failed' >&2; exit 9; }; fi
else
  yarn install --silent || { echo 'deps-001: yarn install failed' >&2; exit 10; }
fi
# Ensure devDependencies exist in package.json; install only missing ones
MISSING_DEVS=()
for pkg in serve @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom @testing-library/user-event; do
  node -e "const p='package.json';if(!require('fs').existsSync(p)){process.exit(0)};const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(p));if(!(j.devDependencies&&j.devDependencies['$pkg'])&&!(j.dependencies&&j.dependencies['$pkg']))process.exit(1);" || MISSING_DEVS+=("$pkg")
done
if [ ${#MISSING_DEVS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev "${MISSING_DEVS[@]}" --silent || { echo 'deps-001: installing devDependencies failed' >&2; exit 11; }; else yarn add --dev "${MISSING_DEVS[@]}" --silent || { echo 'deps-001: yarn add dev failed' >&2; exit 12; }; fi
fi
# verify serve binary
if [ -f node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then true; else echo 'deps-001: serve binary missing after install' >&2; exit 13; fi
exit 0

steps.name: start (dev server)
steps.description: Start the CRA development server headless for verification with BROWSER=none and HOST=0.0.0.0. Check port availability first, launch server in its own process group so children can be killed, poll for readiness, and ensure clean termination. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
cd "$WS"
# verify port free
if ss -ltn sport = :$PORT 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then echo "start-001: port $PORT already in use" >&2; exit 16; fi
# ensure start script exists
node -e "const f='package.json';let j=require('./'+f);j.scripts=j.scripts||{};if(!j.scripts.start)j.scripts.start='react-scripts start';require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LOG=$(mktemp /tmp/cra.start.log.XXXX)
export BROWSER=none
export HOST=0.0.0.0
# start in new process group
setsid npm start >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p $PID | tr -d ' ')
cleanup(){ rv=$?; if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; if [ $rv -ne 0 ]; then echo '--- server log ---' >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2 || true; fi; rm -f "$LOG" || true; exit $rv; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# poll for readiness (flexible probe: root or static asset)
OK=1
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -sS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/static/js/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then OK=0; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ $OK -ne 0 ]; then echo 'start-001: dev server did not respond' >&2; exit 17; fi
echo 'start ok'

Does not depend on dev-server start. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
PORT=${VALIDATION_PORT:-3000}
cd "$WS"
if [ ! -d build ]; then
  npm run build --silent || { echo 'validation-001: build failed' >&2; exit 21; }
fi
SERVE_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/serve"
[ -x "$SERVE_BIN" ] || { echo 'validation-001: serve binary not found; please run deps-001' >&2; exit 22; }
# check port availability
if ss -ltn sport = :$PORT 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then echo "validation-001: port $PORT already in use" >&2; exit 23; fi
LOG=$(mktemp /tmp/serve.log.XXXX)
# start serve in its own process group
setsid "$SERVE_BIN" -s build -l "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p $PID | tr -d ' ')
_cleanup(){ rv=$?; if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; if [ $rv -ne 0 ]; then echo '--- serve log ---' >&2; sed -n '1,500p' "$LOG" >&2 || true; fi; rm -f "$LOG" || true; exit $rv; }
trap _cleanup EXIT
# poll for readiness
OK=1
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then OK=0; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ $OK -ne 0 ]; then echo 'validation-001: server did not respond within timeout' >&2; echo '--- serve log ---' >&2; sed -n '1,500p' "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 24; fi
echo 'validation ok'
exit 0
